title: Wanted to hear your comments about this AI game that I’m currently working on
author: NetVisual2729
selftext: So basically I made my first ai generated game last week using manyverse.ai. Today I made this one which I think looks a bit cleaner compared to my last project. Accepting suggestions from you guys especially since this is just my 2nd time I’m still exploring the app right now.

comments.author: angrylittledev
comments.body: That doesn't seem like a game it looks like bunch of videos stitched together.  Also just another shitty AD for another random place. It doesn't say anything about the process of how the game was made or anything.

comments.author: Tramagust
comments.body: Is this just an ad for manyverse?

replies.author: M4xs0n
replies.body: If it is, it isn’t a good one. This looks like shit and not a real Game

replies.author: NetVisual2729
replies.body: It’s more of an interactive type of game. I’m still figuring out how to do the controls

comments.author: NatalieKCY
comments.body: Where even is any gameplay? You aren't selling anything if you don't even have an actual game mechanic inside your so called game.

comments.author: fued
comments.body:
It's pretty but the gameplay looks garbage

Maybe think about turning it into a movie/anime instead

comments.author: fisj
comments.body: It would be fine to use video as a medium to aid in communicating your game. But the post text itself focuses and promotes a commercial game platform (in essence). In the future if you want feedback, focus describing you game and questions you have for the community, not mentioning the platform.

comments.author: aigamedev-ModTeam
comments.body:
No Posts Promoting Commercial Services or Products

Direct or indirect promotion of commercial services or products is not allowed.

Discussion about services and products is fine, up to a point. Overt and repeated promotion is not, even if its only in comments.

No promotion of commercial services or products - Commercial GAMES are OK, but direct or indirect promotion of commercial services or products is not allowed. Discussion about them is fine, but overt and repeated promotion is not.
